ai.title: AI product content
ai.subtitle: Prepare, review and import content for each shop.
ai.settingsDescription: Content rules, category profiles, automation and processing history.
ai.setupHelp: OpenAI processing is not enabled yet. You can prepare rules after unlocking AI settings.
ai.setupInstructions: Create a separate API project and project key in OpenAI Platform. Your server administrator adds it to /opt/inventory-hub/ai-content.env, sets the Hub access token, enables AI and restarts the API as described in docs/ai-content.md.
ai.independentAccount: The API project can belong to another account. This connection does not use a ChatGPT subscription or ChatGPT project. API billing is separate.
ai.unlockHelp: Use the Hub access token configured by your server administrator. Do not enter an OpenAI API key here.
ai.legacyCategoryRulesHelp: These rules were preserved from earlier versions. You can edit or remove them; manage standard instructions and parameters in the profile under Categories.
ai.rulesHelp: Rules apply in order: common → supplier → brand → category → shop → product → this preparation. Empty settings inherit. Saving creates a draft; publishing applies it to new jobs.
ai.restoreHelp: Load, compare and republish an earlier version. Existing jobs retain their original rules.
ai.officialDomains: Preferred official websites (optional, comma separated; AI can discover others)
ai.parametersHelp: AI can fill only the listed parameters. Missing required evidence blocks import. Variant parameters must match the existing feed choice axes.
ai.allowedValues: Allowed values separated by | (empty = free value)
ai.ruleBookWholeVersion: The file contains the entire rule book, including categories, scopes and automation policies for all shops. Check that other shops are preserved before saving. Import creates a new draft and does not change the published version.
ai.ruleBookAwaitingValidation: The file has not been saved or validated. The server checks every field when saving. Enter the reason for change at the bottom of the editor.
ai.ruleBookSaved: Imported draft #{{version}} is saved and loaded. Published version remains #{{published}}.
ai.ruleBookTooLarge: The file exceeds the 2 MiB limit.
ai.ruleBookInvalid: Choose valid book JSON with rules and categories fields, or an output containing a book object.
ai.ruleBookRejected: The server rejected the book. Check rule and category fields, unique IDs and supported limits. The loaded book is preserved.
ai.ruleBookChanged: The published book has changed. Reload the rules and compare the import with the new version before saving.
ai.ruleBookReadFailed: Draft #{{version}} was saved but could not be loaded. Load the saved draft again; this will not create another version.
ai.publishDraftHelp: First enter a reason for the change and save a draft. You can then publish it for new jobs.
ai.proposalHelp: AI uses the published profile. It proposes instructions and optionally the category parameter registry. Proposals are never published automatically.
ai.proposalPlaceholder: What should be added or clarified?
ai.acceptProposal: Save proposal as a rule draft
ai.estimateHelp: This estimate is not an invoice or a guaranteed price. The allowance counts towards the Hub budget and is replaced by recorded usage after the response.
ai.evidenceSourceHelp: Use feed:<id> for feed data or the exact opened HTTPS URL for a web source. Only select a page that supports this claim; a recorded opening does not establish factual accuracy. Save corrections without generating AI content again.
ai.evidenceQuoteHelp: Edit the claim and quote as needed. Use a verbatim feed passage or exact name: value parameter pairs from the same product, separated by semicolons. Save content draft validates without calling AI. A quotation mismatch or missing source-opening record is a warning: it does not block import or require manual approval on its own.
ai.openedSources: Pages recorded as opened during this preparation
ai.noOpenedSources: This preparation has no recorded opened web page.

evidenceErrors.invalid_https_url: A valid complete HTTPS URL is required. A page title or official: label is not enough.
evidenceErrors.query_not_allowed: The check does not accept URL query parameters after ?. Use a matching verified source; removing parameters alone does not prove the page was opened.
evidenceErrors.not_opened: This exact URL is not among the recorded opened pages.
evidenceErrors.feed_quote_not_found: The quote was not found in the specified feed product. Check both the source and quote.

ai.researchFeed: Feed only – quick processing without additional research

availabilitySync.subtitle: Read supplier availability and send shared stock to BIKETREK and xTrek. Each job has its own interval and manual start.
availabilitySync.tokenHelp: Use the existing operator token. It stays only in this browser tab’s memory.
availabilitySync.suppliersHelp: Reads availability at the supplier. This does not change our physical stock. Refreshing settings replaces unsaved edits.
availabilitySync.supplierLabels: Available at supplier: {{available}}. Unknown or stale: {{unknown}}; the item remains orderable.
availabilitySync.freshnessHelp: Must cover the refresh interval. Expired availability becomes “overíme” (we will check).
availabilitySync.coverage: Warn when item count drops below (%)
availabilitySync.coverageHelp: Compared with the last complete refresh. Valid items in smaller feeds are still accepted; missing items are never replaced with zeroes.
availabilitySync.itemCount: Items in the last accepted source
availabilitySync.unsaved: Unsaved changes — save them or refresh settings first.
availabilitySync.supplierQueued: Refresh queued. Reload the status to see the result.

availabilitySync.requestFailed: The request could not be completed.
availabilitySync.stockHelp: Transfers changes to free stock in the shared warehouse and availability: SKLADOM, supplier lead time, or orderable “overíme”. Stock changes from orders placed in the same Upgates shop are not sent a second time. Product names, prices and images stay unchanged.
availabilitySync.serverDisabled: Stock writes are disabled on the server. Saving settings does not enable them.
availabilitySync.warehouseHelp: These values apply to shops without an override. Saving changes every shop that inherits them.

availabilitySync.authorized: Allow stock transfers to this shop

availabilitySync.stockQueued: Transfer accepted. Follow the run detail and verified results.
availabilitySync.morePending: Additional items remain to be processed.

capacity.title: API capacity · {{shop}}
capacity.help: Reads the selected shop’s API status once and compares it with the Hub catalog. It does not change stock or settings or enable synchronization.
capacity.failed: API status could not be verified. Check the connection and try again later.
capacity.quotaHelp: Remaining quota is a snapshot at the time of the check and can also be used by other integrations. The theoretical 24-hour limit is not today’s remaining quota. With a sample check, this balance is observed before the product requests.
capacity.missingQuota: Upgates did not provide all limit information. A missing value remains unknown; it does not mean zero.
capacity.writeUntested: This check only reads. Writes to the shop and its stock-deduction behavior were not tested by this measurement.
capacity.estimateTitle: Request estimate from the Hub catalog
capacity.estimateHelp: A hypothetical calculation for all items passing basic eligibility at the saved intervals, even with automation disabled. It assumes verified starting balances for every item and ready order processing. Eligibility does not mean an item is already ready to publish. These are not measured usage figures or a speed guarantee.
capacity.intervals: Saved intervals: stock {{stock}} s · orders {{orders}} s.
capacity.alternatives: The first two rows are alternative scenarios; do not add them together. The unchanged daily estimate includes periodic audits, although normal passes between audits require no API requests.
capacity.excluded: The estimate excludes new orders, extra list pages, errors and retries, manual operations, other integrations and other Hub synchronization.

capacity.batchReadsHelp: This comparison covers reading the full selection during an audit or when all items change; a work batch contains up to {{count}} SKUs. Splits by product type and query length are included. The percentage does not represent savings across all API requests.
capacity.changedReadsHelp: After a batch read verifies the exact item and a valid quantity, each changed item receives one stock increment or decrement together with availability. capacity.auditHelp: Between audits, unchanged stock data and availability are checked only in Hub, using no API requests. Shop quantities are audited every {{hours}} hours: {{calls}} requests for the full selection. The unchanged daily estimate includes these audits.

fifoCostSync.title: Purchase costs in shops
fifoCostSync.subtitle: The next FIFO unit cost on products and the weighted cost of the units actually issued on orders.
fifoCostSync.tokenHelp: Use operator access to read and change Hub settings.
fifoCostSync.uncertainResponse: The request response could not be confirmed. Writes are not retried automatically. For a cost transfer refresh its exact details; for a settings save reload settings.
fifoCostSync.requestFailed: The request could not be completed. Check the current status.

fifoCostSync.warehouseHelp: These values apply to shops connected to this warehouse unless a shop sets an override.
fifoCostSync.flagsHelp: Product and order permissions apply to manual and automatic sends. Enable the schedule separately.
fifoCostSync.productHelp: Products receive the known cost of the oldest available FIFO layer after receiving, issuing or a documented correction. Empty stock and unknown or provisional costs never overwrite the price with zero.
fifoCostSync.orderHelp: Only after physical issue: the cost of the actual FIFO units divided by issued quantity. Reservations do not consume FIFO layers. Automatic processing covers issues from activation, including earlier-created orders. Select an earlier-issued order below.
fifoCostSync.automatic: Check and send purchase costs regularly

invoiceArchive.unknownAmounts: {{count}} documents have incomplete amounts or payment information. Incomplete totals appear as —.

invoiceArchive.noChartData: No data for this overview yet.
invoiceArchive.loadFailed: Could not load documents. Try refreshing the page.
invoiceArchive.statsFailed: Could not load the overview. The document list is still available.
invoiceArchive.downloadFailed: Could not download the files. Check the selection and availability of original files.
invoiceArchive.exportHelp: Select documents on this page. The ZIP contains original files and a document list in CSV.
invoiceArchive.selectPage: Select every document on this page
invoiceArchive.uploaded: The file was added to the archive.
invoiceArchive.uploadFailed: Upload was not confirmed. Check the archive before retrying to avoid a duplicate.

invoiceArchive.syncStopped: Downloading paused. Continue once shop access is available.
invoiceArchive.syncFailed: Could not confirm the download result.
invoiceArchive.syncUncertain: Refresh the archive and repeat the same batch. Existing source documents will not be duplicated.
invoiceArchive.metadataFailed: Save was not confirmed. Refresh the document and check current data before another change.
invoiceArchive.amountLocked: Supplier and shop source data and the financial basis of documents with recorded payments are protected from overwriting.
invoiceArchive.manualPaymentsHelp: Payment entries are records only. They do not send bank payments or move stock.
invoiceArchive.openingPaidAmount: Verified amount already settled before this entry
invoiceArchive.openingPaidHelp: The source does not provide a verified payment balance. Enter the actual previously settled amount; use 0 only if nothing was paid. Use a negative amount for a credit note.
invoiceArchive.paymentSignsHelp: Enter a positive amount for the new entry. Credit note settlement follows the negative document direction. A payment refund reduces the recorded settlement.
invoiceArchive.paymentFailed: The payment entry was rejected. Check the amount, date and document information.
invoiceArchive.paymentUncertain: The payment result is not yet confirmed. Further changes are blocked; recover the result or repeat the exact same request.
invoiceArchive.paymentRecoveryPending: A saved result is not available yet. The original request has been retained.
invoiceArchive.conflict: The document has changed. Load the current version and review your changes.
invoiceArchive.noPaymentHistory: No separate manual payment entries have been recorded in the Hub. Any source payment state appears in the summary.
invoiceArchive.reverseHelp: A reversal adds an opposite entry. The original payment remains in history and no bank transaction is changed.
invoiceArchive.parseIncomplete: Document lines could not be fully processed. Check the original file.
invoiceArchive.noLines: No processed lines are available for this document. The original file can be downloaded.

invoiceArchive.reconcileDone: The available supplier records have been checked. Any conflicts are shown above.
invoiceArchive.reconcileFailed: Document reconciliation was not confirmed. Refresh the archive and repeat the same batch.
